raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":441,"db":"MYSQL","query":"SELECT s.stock_name, (f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 10000 / s.total_shares AS bps, s.current_price FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND (f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 10000 / s.total_shares > s.current_price"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"查询2025年每股净资产超过股价的股票","tables":["MYSQL:finance_tax.stocks","MYSQL:finance_tax.company_financials"],"columns":["stock_name","total_assets","total_liabilities","total_shares","current_price","report_date"]}],"assumptions":["每股净资产按(总资产-总负债)*10000/总股本计算，总资产和总负债单位为万元，需转换为元","2025年数据取2025年12月31日报告期","输出股票名称、每股净资产和股价"]}
